modernity.evidence: Grey table grid with black cell borders and a navy title bar; looks like an unstyled 1990s page.

visual_hierarchy.evidence: Red all-caps service list shouts; the rest is one dense paragraph and bare text cells for navigation.

mobile_usability.evidence: Fixed-width table is scaled down to the phone width; the text is very small.

readability.evidence: Navy-on-navy title is almost unreadable; grey body text on grey cells is low contrast.

imagery_quality.evidence: Grey cells labelled "[logo]", "[photo camion]" and an empty box instead of images.

trust_signals.evidence: Phone and fax numbers in the footer and "20 ans d'experience" in the text, but "page en construction".

cta_clarity.evidence: No button and no quote form; navigation is plain text in table cells.

brand_consistency.evidence: No logo, only a barely visible title and red shouting text on grey.

summary.en: Bare, low-contrast table page with placeholder images and shouting text. Contact numbers are present but there is no clear action or brand.
summary.fr: Page en tableau brute et peu contrastée, avec des images factices et un texte en majuscules criardes. Les numéros sont présents mais sans action claire ni identité visuelle.
